t: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums, not to exceed $2,000,000, as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this joint resolution.

fable.w: This section only authorizes appropriations of up to $2,000,000 to carry out the joint resolution. The tempting reading is that the underlying joint resolution might involve a commission or outside parties, but nothing in this section's text involves anyone outside the federal government in a federal decision. It has no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue.
fable.s: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums, not to exceed $2,000,000, as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this joint resolution.

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard authorization of appropriations clause. It merely sets a funding limit for the government to carry out its duties. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government, nor does it establish any advisory bodies or public comment periods.
qwen_block.s: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums, not to exceed $2,000,000, as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this joint resolution.

opus.w: This provision only authorizes appropriations to carry out a joint resolution. No party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision, and there is no comment period, hearing, advisory body, or right to sue. Like Example 1, it is a funding provision, so it is not participation.
opus.s: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums, not to exceed $2,000,000, as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this joint resolution.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a standard appropriations clause authorizing the expenditure of funds. It does not contain any language requiring or recommending consultation, coordination, or participation with entities outside the federal government. The mere authorization of funds does not constitute participation.
qwen_chat.s: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums, not to exceed $2,000,000, as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this joint resolution.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that because the funds are appropriated to "carry out the provisions of this joint resolution," and if those other provisions involved participation, this section indirectly supports it. However, this specific section is purely a funding authorization. It does not itself mandate, recommend, or describe any process of consultation, coordination, or involvement with outside parties. It is a standard appropriations clause.
